prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: eight production-ready transparent 2.5D game environment PERIMETER MODULES.
Create one high-resolution wide horizontal 3200x1600 PNG with REAL TRANSPARENT alpha, exactly 4 COLUMNS × 2 ROWS, eight equal cells. Each cell has ONE isolated complete self-contained scenery module, no labels/text/no grid strokes, no HUD/no characters, no backdrop beyond the object, no painted checkerboard. Generous transparent gutters, 15% clear margins around each entire module, NEVER cropped tips or feet, NEVER overlapping cell boundaries. These are modular cutout environment props, not a complete map, not eight photographs.
Reference image is STYLE ONLY. Match its bright hand-painted cartoon fantasy, sunny upper-left light, warm sand-gold and terracotta red rocks, ivory tusks, vivid indigo flags, short pleasant shadows, high-angle three-quarter near-isometric 2.5D thickness. Low readable external scenery for an open ORC/OGRE tribal arena. No gritty darkness. Low pieces should be broad-and-short, not giant obstructing walls.
Order left-to-right top-to-bottom:
TOP ROW:
1 NORTH: a SHORT SEGMENTED TERRACOTTA TRIBAL WALL, three uneven LOW reddish clay masonry sections connected by two short ivory tusk posts, indigo knot ties and one tiny sunny drum emblem. Cap blocks hand-painted in their own 3D perspective. Wall waist-high, compact complete segment, no continuous towering wall, no ground-texture extrusion.
2 EAST: naturally LAYERED LOW SUNLIT RED SANDSTONE OUTCROP, three rounded staggered rock shelves in terracotta, ochre and warm cream with a few fresh green desert sprigs, broad organic silhouette, no rectangular base, no floating chunky square tile. Rock mass only, transparent beyond it.
3 SOUTH: ROUGH WOOD AND BONE LOW FENCE, three short rustic wood stakes joined by pale curved rib-bone rails and dark-blue rope, deliberately open gaps. Short fence only, warm sunlit grain, nothing towering, no ground.
4 WEST: TRIBAL SHADE SHED BACKGROUND, small open-sided rustic bone/wood shelter with cream and indigo stitched cloth roof, one quiet terracotta jar and short drum tucked in its side, rounded ivory curved posts; complete roof and feet visible, no people, NO opaque rectangle behind the shelter.
BOTTOM ROW:
5 CORNER: CURVING SAND-SLOPE GRASS AND ROCK TRANSITION CLUSTER, a modest organic crescent of rounded ochre stones, warm sand tufts and green desert plants, low stepped red-rock accent; irregular fading natural outline, NO rectangular ground slab, NO whole meadow. Designed as a curved corner edge cutout.
6 FOREGROUND: a LOW DESERT GRASS TUFT CLUSTER, three small lively green and straw-gold tufts with two rounded terracotta pebbles joined in one compact cluster. Maximum low knee-high silhouette, airy translucent leaves, no dirt square, no floor plane.
7 GATEWAY: IVORY TUSK TRIBAL ENTRANCE, broad complete open arch made from two gentle curved tusks and short terracotta base posts, little indigo sun-pattern ribbons and bone bead knots. Door opening genuinely transparent, no actual door leaf, no floor slab or stairs, NOT a high oppressive fort wall.
8 BACKDROP: INDIGO CLAN FLAGS AND WAR DRUM GROUP, three curved ivory standards with differently shaped indigo banners plus two short decorated hide drums, linked by a thin bone-bead garland. Bright sun/tusk/drum pictograms but no letters. Compact ensemble as background landmark decoration, airy silhouette, not a whole landscape.
All 8 modules share camera, outline weight, game scale and sun direction. Each lower baseline is centered within its own cell with small local semi-transparent contact shadow only. Transparent spaces must exist through fence gaps, arch opening, shelter opening and flag gaps. Do not include any floor tile, map, square plate, gray rim or solid-color backdrop. The purpose is to build natural four-sided map edges from these genuinely layered cutout sprites. Perimeter elements are non-colliding backdrop/foreground decorations.
Avoid: repeated floor texture lifted vertically, hard gray border, gigantic pillars/walls, floating square slab, giant pit/water block, industrial winches/rust coils/mine carts, text, opaque white/gray background, characters, extra ninth object, overlapping/cropped cells.
